# hubspot_workflow (Data Source)

Looks up a workflow via the Automation v4 API (**public beta**) by flow ID or by exact name (an ambiguous name is an error). Exposes the complete flow definition as JSON — useful for referencing unmanaged automation or writing point-in-time backups. Requires the `automation` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing workflow by its exact name (errors if the name is
# ambiguous) — handy for referencing unmanaged automation, or for backing up
# a flow definition before adopting it with `terraform import`.
data "hubspot_workflow" "welcome" {
  name = "Welcome new leads"
}

# ...or directly by flow ID.
data "hubspot_workflow" "by_id" {
  flow_id = "567890123"
}

# The complete flow definition as returned by the Automation v4 API, e.g. for
# writing point-in-time backups of automation alongside your state.
output "welcome_flow_backup" {
  value = data.hubspot_workflow.welcome.flow_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `flow_id` (String) The workflow's flow ID. Exactly one of `flow_id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Exact workflow name to look up. Exactly one of `flow_id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workflow is turned on and enrolling objects.
- `flow_json` (String) The complete flow definition as returned by the Automation v4 API, including server-managed fields — suitable for backups. (The `hubspot_workflow` resource's `flow_json` argument instead excludes fields managed by typed attributes.)
- `flow_type` (String) Workflow type: `CONTACT_FLOW` or `PLATFORM_FLOW`.
- `id` (String) Identifier for the data source (the flow ID).
- `object_type_id` (String) Object type the workflow runs on (e.g. `0-1` for contacts).
- `revision_id` (String) The flow's current revision, advanced by HubSpot on every write.
